summary: Completed comprehensive frontend UI testing of Lowkey Next.js app neon UI redesign (iteration 3). All 12 features tested and verified working correctly. The app now has a smooth electric premium feel with neon borders, different accent colors per page unified in tone, and nightlife premium social dating chill spot aesthetic.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data - 7 lounges and founder account
context_for_next_testing_agent: All neon UI redesign features verified working. Login has purple neon theme with glass card, neon outlined buttons, and neon input borders. Home page has People Online section with circular avatars and green online dots, Active Lounges with neon-colored border cards (blue, gold, red, purple), Quick Access section with 5 tiles, and bottom navigation with purple active state. Lounge list page has search bar, stats line, and clickable lounge cards with neon accent borders and tags.

1_login_neon_purple_theme.details: Login page renders with neon purple theme - glass card styling, neon-btn class on submit button with purple border (1.5px solid rgba(147,51,234,0.5)) and glow (box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(147,51,234,0.15)), lk-input-neon class on inputs

2_login_flow.details: Login works: filled email kinglowkey@hotmail.com and password password123, clicked Sign In, onboarding modal appeared, dismissed it, successfully redirected to home page

3_people_online_section.details: Home page has People Online section with circular avatars (T letter placeholders) and green online dots visible

4_active_lounges_section.details: Home page has Active Lounges section with 4 lounge cards showing neon-colored borders (blue, gold, red, purple accents via data-accent attribute)

5_lounge_card_details.details: Each lounge card shows: bold title (font-weight >= 600), Live indicator with green dot, description text, member count (e.g., '23 online'), Join → arrow link

6_quick_access_section.details: Quick Access section at bottom of Home has 5 icon tiles: Inbox, After Dark, Games, Radio, Events

7_bottom_navigation.details: Bottom navigation has 4 tabs: Home (purple active - SVG color rgb(147,51,234)), Lounge, After Dark, Profile. Other tabs dimmed at rgba(255,255,255,0.2)

8_lounge_list_title.details: Lounge list page (/lounge) shows title 'Lounges' with 'Find your vibe' subtitle

9_lounge_search_and_stats.details: Lounge list page has search bar (placeholder: 'Search lounges...') and stats line showing '7 active' and '61 people online'

10_lounge_cards_neon_borders.details: Lounge cards on list page have neon accent borders (blue, gold, red, purple, pink, emerald) with tags (e.g., 'late night', 'vibes', 'chill', 'relaxed')

11_no_heavy_gradient_buttons.details: No heavy solid-color gradient buttons found anywhere - all buttons are neon outlined (transparent fill with glowing border) or text links

12_lounge_card_navigation.details: Clicking a lounge card navigates to the lounge chat view with message input, send button, and header showing lounge name and online count
